info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Webhook Subscriptions API
info.description: The Manage Webhook Subscriptions API allows users to effectively manage their webhook subscriptions, providing a means to unsubscribe from specific notifications. This operation is particularly important for maintaining relevant communication and ensuring that users receive only the notifications that matter to them. Typical consumers include application developers and system administrators who integrate services and require control over webhook delivery. By removing unwanted webhook subscriptions, users can optimize their notification handling processes, improving overall application efficiency.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific webhook identified by its unique resource identifier. Use this operation to manage and clean up webhook subscriptions that are no longer needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details regarding the deletion of the webhook identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the payload conforms to the defined schema for a successful operation.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content returned.

DeleteWebhookRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation. It is expected to be a string.

DeleteWebhookRes100045Response_204.description: Response schema for successful DELETE operation, indicating that the resource has been deleted.

x-endpoint-id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint associated with this webhook operation.

x-runtime-app.description: The name of the application that initiated the webhook operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication mechanism with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include a valid JWT token in the 'Authorization' header of their requests to authenticate and gain access to protected resources.
